caption:
console.log calls written during development often ship to production. Anyone who opens DevTools can read them: user emails, auth tokens, full API responses.

Two fixes:
- remove them before merging (ESLint's no-console rule catches them)
- strip them at build time with your bundler's minifier settings

And never log a token, even while debugging. Logs get copied, screenshotted and pasted into AI chats.

Try it on your project tonight. It takes two minutes.

Source: ESLint docs, no-console rule.
